queue.title: How to Turn monday.com Status Changes into Automatic Contract Drafts
queue.brief: Every time a deal moves to "Won" in monday.com, your team scrambles to draft a contract — here's how to make that document appear automatically. This post shows how to connect board triggers to document generation so nothing falls through the cracks between a verbal yes and a signed agreement.
queue.description: H2 sections cover: "Why the gap between 'Won' and signed contract costs you deals," "Setting up a status-change trigger in monday.com," "What data to pull into your contract automatically (client name, scope, pricing columns)," "How DocuAI generates a ready-to-send contract draft the moment status changes," and "Sending for signature without leaving monday.com." Target keyword: "automatically generate contracts from monday.com." Real-world example: a SaaS sales team that cut contract turnaround from 48 hours to under 5 minutes by triggering DocuAI drafts on every "Closed Won" status update.
